chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The most capable of pardoning is he who is the most powerful to punish.
ai.seo_question: What is the most capable of pardoning according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links the virtue of pardon (afw) directly to the capacity for justice (qudra), suggesting that forgiveness is most meritorious when it is a conscious choice by the powerful rather than a necessity of the weak. This concept is central to Shia ethical theology, where leadership is defined by the restraint of power and the elevation of moral character over mere authority. It reflects the broader Islamic ideal that true nobility lies in the ability to forgive when one has the right to punish.
